purpose: PSG1 SELECT/View and START/Menu control-hint artwork. Labels are intentionally baked as explicitly requested.

seed.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Production Battle Cities PSG1 controller-hint asset: ONE small physical SELECT button icon.
Input image 1 (round face button) and input image 2 (shoulder button) are MATERIAL/STYLE REFERENCES: match their polished translucent dark indigo-blue/purple console plastic, subtle internal purple depth, bright lavender upper-left bevel highlight, dark lower rim and restrained glossy finish. Do not copy their round or wide shoulder silhouette.
Shape: compact horizontal rounded oval/soft capsule button, approximately 2.3 times as wide as tall, matching the small PSG1 SELECT/START physical menu buttons. Straight-on orthographic view, symmetric silhouette, shallow tactile thickness. Soft low-profile bevel, no large surrounding frame or console body.
Exact centered lettering: SELECT. S E L E C T, uppercase, ONE word only. Clean pale white/lavender Barlow Condensed Bold-style lettering, flat face, no outline or drop shadow, no grunge or texture inside letters. Large readable type occupying about 68% of button width and 40% of height; high contrast on a quiet dark purple center, clear of reflective rim. Must remain legible at roughly 56x26 logical pixels.
Technical: ONE complete isolated button, square or wide canvas is acceptable but fill most of the width, a small transparent safe margin and no clipped edges. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. No ground shadow, glow aura, illustration, controller shell, labels above/below, decorative marks, symbols, tiny writing, text other than SELECT, second button, comparison sheet or backdrop. Only one SELECT button icon.

normalization: Alpha below 8 cleared, alpha >=248 made opaque; retain center-connected physical button; trim; aspect-preserving Lanczos fit within 496x208 on a 512x224 transparent canvas. No letter painting or recoloring in export.

usage.rendering: Simple image with preserveAspect=true; never stretch or nine-slice baked lettering.
usage.recommendedWidth: 64 logical pixels or larger where space permits

assets.label: SELECT
assets.prompt: Edit the supplied PSG1 SELECT button. Preserve the entire button body EXACTLY: horizontal capsule silhouette, dimensions, depth, blue-purple transparent plastic, bevel highlights, reflections, dark base, position and transparent outer background. Change ONLY its white lettering. Keep the same clean condensed bold uppercase font, pale-white/lavender color, flat letter face, zero outline/shadow and centered baseline. Enlarge lettering by about 30% compared with reference: glyph HEIGHT should be roughly 50% of the button's full visible height, leaving ample clear margin before upper/lower rim. Lettering must read clearly when the entire button is only 56x26 logical pixels. No changes outside lettering, no extra symbols, text, labels, objects, glow or backdrop; complete one isolated button on true transparent RGBA. Exact final text: SELECT (S E L E C T). Keep all six letters and scale the word to approximately 66–70% of the visible button width, horizontally centered.
